Frame: Stepanov's method

Stepanov (1969) gave an elementary proof of the Riemann Hypothesis for curves over finite fields. The chain on the right repeats his scheme over Q; the missing Frobenius is replaced by a chain of lifts. The interpretation is ours; the author did not write it this way.

**Stepanov's global Frobenius is split here into three roles:**
1. One CM field gives a local Frobenius at every inert p.
2. A chain of lifts with Hecke gives multiplicity.
3. Characters of an abelian field sort the primes.
The interpretation is ours.
